lines.text: Oh... um. Hi. Is it okay if I sit here? In the corner? I won't be in the way.
Oh... you're open. I came by a few times. It was closed. I thought maybe... never mind. I'm glad you're okay.
Last time was... it was fine! Really. I ate all of it.
I kept thinking about my last meal here. Is that weird? Sorry.
Sorry. Hi. I'm back. If that's okay.
Um... is the corner table free? It's fine if it's not.
Hello... I hope it's not too busy. I can come back later if it is.
[name]! You're back. I walked past every day, just in case.
I told my reflection about your cooking. It was the only one listening. Ha. That was a joke.
Hi, [name]. ...I practiced saying your name on the way here. Is that weird? Don't answer that.
I'm back! I mean. Hi. A normal amount of excited.
You're back! I missed this place. I missed... you know. Talking to you.
Last time was a little crispy. I'm only telling you because you said I could be honest with you.
[name]! Guess what. I finished a new patch. Look, it has little stars on it.
I saved the corner table. ...Okay, nobody else ever takes it. But I saved it anyway.
There you are! I was about to sew a 'missing chef' poster.
[name]! I'm here! Your favorite customer! ...Is that too much? No. I'm owning it.
I sat at a middle table today. In the middle. Where people can see me. Are you proud of me? You can say yes.
I keep thinking about when you said "[last_rude_line]". ...I'm sure you were just busy.
Hi... um. Did I do something wrong last time? You can tell me. I'll fix it.
Can I ask your name? You know mine. It feels rude that I don't know yours. ...[name]. That's a nice name. I'll remember it. I promise.
Thank you. Sorry for the trouble. I wiped the table already.
I'll... maybe come back? If that's okay.
See you soon, [name]. I still wiped the table. Old habits.
Can I leave the table for you this time? ...I trust you not to mind.
Bye, [name]! Same time tomorrow? I'm not asking. I'm telling you.
Thank you. Sorry.
Thank you.
Oh... it's beautiful. You made this? For me? Thank you. Really.
Thank you so much. It smells really nice.
It's... it's perfect. Thank you.
Thank you, [name]. It looks so good. I'm going to eat it slowly so it lasts.
You remembered I like it warm. ...Or you didn't, and I'm just lucky. Either way.
You burnt the edge a little. I'm still eating all of it. I'm just letting you know I noticed.
[name], this looks amazing. You always make me feel like I'm worth the effort.
Thank you. Sorry.
Oh! Hi. Is something wrong? Am I eating too slow?
It's quiet in here today. I like quiet. ...I'm used to it.
Sorry if I'm staring at the kitchen. It's nice watching someone make something with care.
Can I tell you something? This is the only place where nobody stares at my patches.
When I was little, my ear got torn off in a fight I didn't start. I sewed it back on myself. It came out crooked. It's still crooked.
Do you ever feel like you're too much? Or not enough? ...Sorry. That's a big question for lunch.
I could fix that loose button on your apron. If you want. I'm good at fixing things. Just not myself. ...That was a joke! Mostly.
I used to think my patches made me broken. Now I think they just make me... me.
I said hi to someone at the park today. First. I went first. My heart was pounding.
Do you need anything mended? I mean it. You've fixed a lot for me. Let me fix something for you.
Did you need something? I'm almost done. I'll go soon.
